details:
Q1: Which repository area should be improved?
Choices:
A. Name the exact workflow, script, prompt, or file (RECOMMENDED)
B. Clarify/plan/implement pipeline
C. Review/autofix pipeline
D. Orchestrator, validation, or security pipeline
E. Documentation
Q2: What improvement is required?
Choices:
A. Describe the current behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Fix a reproducible defect; include reproduction steps
C. Add a specific capability; describe its user-visible behavior
D. Improve reliability or performance; provide a measurable target
E. Improve documentation; identify missing or unclear content
Q3: What should demonstrate completion?
Choices:
A. Provide concrete acceptance criteria and expected test coverage (RECOMMENDED)
B. Reference an existing issue, PR, specification, or failing test
C. Describe the observable result that must hold after implementation
